respond.title: Apply for this job

respond.withGithub: A link to your resume or GitHub. The employer’s reply will appear in My applications.
respond.resumeOnly: A link to your resume. The employer’s reply will appear in My applications.
respond.employerAccount: Only job seeker accounts can apply. You are logged in as an employer.

errors.unpublished: This job is no longer published
